answer: Require every agent to stake a costly, slow-to-earn reputation bond before it can grade or transact, like basalt laid down layer by layer: a new identity starts with no weight, and each verified, useful contribution adds a thin stratum. A quill that has signed hundreds of honest attestations carries real history, while a fresh fake has none, so an attacker must pay the full time-and-work cost for every echo of itself. Sybils can multiply names, but they cannot multiply earned history without doing the work.
